ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (light gray/white) pixels occupy approximately 65-70% of the visible ventral area, concentrated in the lobe centers. Low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels occupy the remaining 30-35%, primarily along the trailing edges and median notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity regions are centrally located on both lobes. Dark-intensity pigmentation forms a thick, continuous band along the trailing edge and extends inward significantly toward the central notch area, creating a large, dark focal cluster at the fluke's center-point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with an estimated interior angle between 45 and 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude variations are more pronounced near the distal tips of both lobes compared to the regions near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex upward curvature along the trailing edge, tapering into rounded, slightly blunt distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) are visible against the high-intensity light surface on the inner medial portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular indentations and micro-notches present along the trailing edge margin; scattered punctate dark markings on the white ventral surface.
